To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a non-linear approach for feature selection is useful for the identification of morphometric features for breast tumor contour in ultrasonic images, and that the proposed method is able to identify morphometric features that contribute to tumor diagnosis.

(1) The convex polygon technique is a promising approach for the extraction of morphometric features from breast tumor contours; (2) A Mutual Information based approach is useful to rank features that contribute to the discrimination of breast tumors in ultrasound; and (3) A non-linear approach is necessary to select features with non-linear contributions to tumor discrimination
a combination of Convex Polygon features and Normalized Radial features is able to identify the tumor contour with 90.9% accuracy.

the development of a non-linear feature selection method based on the combination of Mutual Information and Linear discriminant analysis for breast tumors contour analysis.
the development of a non-linear feature selection approach to identify the most relevant features for tumor contour discrimination in ultrasonic images.
developing and validating a novel approach to select morphometric features from breast tumor contours for the purpose of improving diagnostic accuracy.
